descriptions.text: It's been a rough few weeks for Justin Sun. Today, another $99M went missing as HECO Bridge and HTX (again) were hacked in short succession. His Excellency makes sure to never stay out of the spotlight for long…
HTX (formerly Huobi) and its related Heco Bridge were hacked for a combined $113.3 million.

On November 22, 2023, the Heco Bridge connecting Ethereum and Huobi ECO Chain suffered a major private key compromise. An attacker gained control of the bridge's operator account on Ethereum, executing rapid withdrawals totaling roughly $86.6 million in assets. The stolen tokens and ether were transferred to external accounts and partially laundered. The Ethereum-side operator EOA controlling the Heco Bridge was compromised, enabling unauthorized withdrawals of reserves. This single-point failure allowed the attacker to drain assets directly, with no contract exploit identified.

On November 22, 2023, the Heco Bridge's operator key was compromised, allowing unauthorized withdrawals totaling approximately $86.6 million across ETH, USDT, HBTC, SHIB, UNI, LINK, and other assets. The incident was an operator access-control failure and not a smart contract bug. The attacker gained access to the Heco Bridge operator's private key, enabling them to sign and authorize withdrawals directly from the Ethereum-side reserves. No smart contract vulnerability was involved.
